title: Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.41785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. translated_title: 剥开俄罗斯套娃：从检索嵌入中提取本体结构
translated_abstract: 分类体系构建对知识密集型自然语言处理至关重要，但成本依然高昂：基于聚类的方法（i）需要针对每个语料库进行细致调参，且产生的层次结构不稳定；而基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线（ii）则依赖昂贵且无法跨领域迁移的任务特定训练。我们报告了一个与上述两个问题都相关的实证发现：在套娃表示学习（MRL）嵌入中，每个前缀向量本身就是一个可用的、更粗糙的向量，而前缀长度与金标准分类体系从粗到细的粒度相对应；通过维度打乱与维度倒序的对照实验，我们将这种对应关系定位到模型学习得到的前部前缀维度上。该模式在三个架构各异的MRL模型中均成立。为验证这一规律是否可用，我们提出了PEEL（剥离嵌入以提取潜在本体）：一个构建于这些冻结嵌入之上的极简探针，仅需使用序嵌入目标训练一次，该目标将层次结构表示为向量包含关系……
tldr: 本文发现MRL嵌入的前缀长度天然对应分类体系由粗到细的粒度，并据此提出仅需训练一次的极简探针PEEL，可直接从冻结的检索嵌入中提取本体层次结构，避免昂贵的调参与任务特定训练。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that prefix length in Matryoshka Representation Learning embeddings aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies, and introduces PEEL, a minimal probe trained once on frozen embeddings to extract ontological hierarchies without costly per-corpus tuning or task-specific training.
